Harmanpreet Kaur Steps Down as India Women's Cricket Captain

Harmanpreet Kaur has stepped down as the captain of the India women's cricket team across all formats. The cricketer, who is India's only World Cup-winning women's captain, announced her decision on Tuesday. Her leadership tenure has been described as an "iconic leadership journey filled with achievements."
